production.n: USGS MCS 2026, platinum plus palladium mine production, PGM content (kg converted to t); 2025 values are USGS estimates; world = sum of the USGS rounded world totals for platinum and palladium; excludes rhodium, ruthenium, iridium and osmium

reserves.n: USGS MCS 2026, platinum-group metals reserves, PGM content (kg converted to t); USGS world total is rounded; USGS reports the world total as a lower bound (>76,000,000)

notes: Trade tonnage in BACI is frequently missing for precious metals and is estimated from value (see percentage in the table note); treat flows as indicative.
Production is platinum plus palladium only (USGS gives no rhodium/ruthenium/iridium/osmium by country); the index unit (kg) is shown here in t.
discrepancies: BACI world exports 1,342 t (2024) are 3.7x USGS world mine production 360 t (2025): trade counts refined/recycled metal and re-exports between hubs several times and is not comparable with mine output; USGS used for production, BACI for trade.
